thread_analysis.thread_summary: Internal report review thread (227 lines) for Sony Corporation A2DP/AVRCP profile test (Bravia FY26). Two issues identified by reviewer Tanaka: (1) A2DP/SRC/SUS/[ID] (Category B) is in the test plan but was not executed — root cause: customer changed ICS mid-project to remove this capability but test plan was not updated; Sakai updated the test plan; (2) AVRCP PTS version mismatch between report (11.5.0.5) and log (11.10.2.3), plus TSPC_ALL=True in log — Tanaka suggested regenerating log with TSPC_ALL=False; Sakai confirmed TSPC_ALL=True is acceptable and no regeneration needed.
all_questions_found: Test plan has a case that was not executed due to customer ICS change — how to handle?
Is TSPC_ALL=True in PTS test logs acceptable? Does the version mismatch between report and log need correction?
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: Two distinct report review issues: (1) test plan synchronization with ICS is a process discipline requirement — the plan must be updated whenever the ICS changes; (2) TSPC_ALL=True is an explicit SIG-accepted PTS configuration that does not require corrective action.
thread_analysis.key_decision_logic: ICS change → test plan must be updated (process rule). TSPC_ALL=True → no action needed (SIG policy). PTS 3-digit vs 4-digit version discrepancy → acceptable (SIG convention).
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Failing to update the test plan after an ICS change causes report review failure. Incorrectly regenerating PTS logs to change TSPC_ALL wastes time with no benefit.
thread_analysis.consulting_mistake: Nakayama (report author) failed to update the test plan when the customer changed the ICS mid-project. This is a process gap — ICS changes should trigger an automatic test plan review.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Establish a process rule: whenever a customer changes their ICS, immediately review and update the test plan. TSPC_ALL=True should be added to the accepted-without-action list in the report QC checklist.
